failure_summary.description: Skill already documents `O.getSomesStruct({...})` from `@beep/utils` for shape-preserving optional compaction, but both agents invented their own substitute (a mapped-type/cast, and a bespoke `compactOptionRecord` helper) instead of writing the literal required call/import.

Both agents left the exported pure-data type as a plain `type`/`interface` (or a cast) instead of also converting the schema-owned model itself into `S.Class`, so the 'no exported interface/type literal remains' verification step was not actually satisfied even though an Option-based helper was added.

patch.reasoning: Both trajectories fail the exact same completion-check family (SFV4-getsomes-struct): the skill already tells the agent to prefer `O.getSomesStruct({...})` from `@beep/utils` for shape-preserving optional compaction, but in practice the agents route around it with a custom local utility or a cast/mapped-type trick that typechecks but does not contain the required literal call/import the deterministic scorer greps for. Separately, both agents treated adding an Option-returning helper as sufficient without also converting the underlying exported data model into `S.Class`, so the exported type/interface remained and tripped the schema-first inventory check. A single generalized addition — call out that literal reuse of `O.getSomesStruct`/`@beep/utils` (not a same-behavior substitute) is required, and that the model's own declaration must become `S.Class` in the same edit — targets both recurring gaps without hardcoding fixture names.

edits.target:
- Use `S.OptionFrom*` when the wire/schema field is optional or nullish. If
    runtime `Option` values are already being shaped into an object, prefer
    `O.getSomesStruct({...})` (`@beep/utils`) for heterogeneous struct spreads
    with known keys — runtime-identical to `R.getSomes` but type-preserving per
    key; reserve `R.getSomes({...})` for homogeneous dynamic-key dictionaries.
    Use `O.all({...})` for all-or-nothing fixed-shape composition. (Amended
    2026-07-05 — see `standards/architecture/DECISIONS.md`.)
edits.content:
- When refactoring an existing optional-field compaction site (a `R.getSomes(...)` call, an `as Partial<...>`/mapped-type cast, or any hand-rolled local helper that reimplements shape-preserving compaction), do not invent a new bespoke utility or type-level workaround as a substitute — write the literal call `O.getSomesStruct({...})` together with `import { O } from "@beep/utils"` directly in the entrypoint file. A type-safe alternative that avoids this exact call/import still fails review even when it typechecks cleanly.
  - When the object being compacted is itself the task's named exported data model (not just a helper's return value), the model's own declaration must also become `S.Class` (or the otherwise-preferred schema construct) in the same edit — e.g. `export class Foo extends S.Class<Foo>("Foo")({...})`. Adding an `O.getSomesStruct`/Option-based helper without also converting the exported `type`/`interface` itself leaves the 'no exported interface/type literal remains' check unsatisfied.
